question: Consider the function $f(x)=\displaystyle\int_0^x[t]dt$ where $x>0$ and $[t]$ denotes the largest integer less than or equal to $t$. Then

options.B: $f(x)$ is defined for all $x>0$ but is not continuous at $x=1,2,3,\ldots$
options.C: $f(x)$ is continuous at all $x>0$ but is not differentiable at $x=1,2,3,\ldots$
